name: Gurvich-Naumova conjecture: {1,...,n} splits into parts of size <= 3 with power-of-3 sums (proved)
result: True for every n >= 1, by an explicit recursion. Constructions: zero-sum triples on symmetric intervals, reflection to [1,T+j], and a fixed-point-free involution with distinct pair sums.
